question.problem: Mike has a box with $7$ red LEGO blocks numbered from $1$ to $7$ and other $7$ blue LEGO blocks numbered from $8$ to $14.$ If Mike chooses a LEGO block at random, what is the probability that he picks a blue LEGO block?
question.worked_solution:
Let $X$ represent the number on the chosen LEGO block. From the problem statement, we know that $X∼U\{1,2,…,14\},$ and we wish to compute $P(8\le X\le 14).$

In general, if $X$ follows a discrete uniform distribution over a set $S,$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{|S|}, & x\in S \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, we have $X∼U\{1,2,…,14\},$ and the set $S$ has $|S|=14$ items. So, we have

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{14}, & x=1,2,…,14 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

In $S,$ the items that satisfy $8\le X\le 14$ are $8,9,10,11,12,13,14.$ There are $7$ of these items. Therefore,

$$
P(8\le X\le 14)=7\cdot \frac{1}{14}=\frac{1}{2}.
$$
